programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS stays close to home as they investigate the Cumberland Library & Monastery in Cumberland, Rhode Island. A massacre that occurred in the spring of 1676 may have been the first of several events to cause the paranormal activity that exists today.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been called to Brunswick, Georgia to investigate Brunswick Old City Hall. Chief Tobe Green has asked the team to investigate reports of paranormal activity that has gone on for years. Construction began in 1889 and by 1890 the top floor was used as the municipal court. In 1890, Officer Robert L. Massey was shot and killed here while trying to arrest a man who was found guilty for a minor offense. Unexplained activity has been reported ever since.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates the abandoned Elizabeth V. Edwards Elementary School in Barnegat, New Jersey. Built in 1930, this was first Barnegat High School until a larger one was built in 1957, turning this into an elementary school. In 1975 the school was renamed Elizabeth V. Edwards. Elizabeth was someone who dedicated her entire life to the education of Barnegat's young people. She passed away in 1965. The school was shut down in 2004.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Client, Rebecca Jordan Gleason has called TAPS back to Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum, in Weston, West Virginia, at a time when they are celebrating their 150th anniversary and Ghost Hunters, their 200th episode. TAPS was here in 2008 and found great evidence. Their parting words to Rebecca were for her to not do anything to stir up more paranormal activity...but that advice was not heeded and the activity has increased.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates five different locations along one of the most haunted streets in America! Main Street in St. Charles, Missouri was built on top of a cemetery, which at one time housed hundreds of bodies. As St. Charles grew, it became inconvenient to have a cemetery in the middle of the city and in 1850 it was decided that bodies should be moved to another area. However, not all of them were removed and buildings were constructed over them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Carthage, Missouri to investigate the Burlingame & Chaffee Opera House. The building has multiple floors and has had various uses over the decades, starting in 1878 when the second floor was an Opera House, the lower level, a hardware store and the basement a mortuary. In the early 1900's the building was sold to Charles E. Turner who owned a carriage and harness company.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Joplin, Missouri to investigate the Holly Hill Estate. The property is comprised of two houses with very different histories. The first house is called Willow Vista, which was built in 1916 and was a private club with ties to the mob. Over the years it was also believed to have been a speakeasy and a brothel. In 1958, a doctor named Donald Patterson bought the Willa Vista and made it into a family home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Joplin, Missouri to investigate the Holly Hill Estate. The property is comprised of two houses with very different histories. The first house is called Willow Vista, which was built in 1916 and was a private club with ties to the mob. Over the years it was also believed to have been a speakeasy and a brothel. In 1958, a doctor named Donald Patterson bought the Willa Vista and made it into a family home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Lawrenceburg, Kentucky to investigate The Wild Turkey Distillery. Guest investigator, Kristen Luman, as well as two familiar faces, Dustin and KJ join the team. The descendent of the founding family, Olivia Ripy, calls the team in to investigate. Her family started making whiskey as far back as 1869 and in 1935, her grandparents went into business as the Ripy Brothers.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Hyde Park, New York to investigate the Culinary Institute of America. Built in the early 1900's the building was originally a seminary for young men looking to become Jesuit priests. It was shut down in 1969 due to diminishing enrollment. The Culinary Institute took over the building two years later.
programme.sub-title: Too Many Apparaitions in the Kitchen

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS stays close to home on this investigation as they travel to Newport, Rhode Island to investigate Fort Adams, the largest coastal fortress ever constructed on US soil. This is the second fort built on the site. The original structure was built in 1799 and stood through 1812. The fort was rebuilt from 1824-1857 and could hold 468 cannons, where as the first could only hold 20. Many deaths were reported but had nothing to do with battle but rather, murder, suicide, and illness.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Louisville, Kentucky to investigate the Conrad-Caldwell Castle, the masterpiece built by well-known architect, Arthur Loomis. The house took 3 years to complete and was the symbol of success for the original owner, Theophilus Conrad and his wife, who started out as poor immigrants before working their way up to being wealthy industrialists. The couple lived in this home for ten years, before Mr. Conrad died of a heart attack on the basement stairs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Lenox, Massachusetts to investigate The Mount, a location they first visited in 2008. Built in 1902, the Mount was designed and built for Pulitzer Prize winning author, Edith Wharton and her husband, Teddy. When their marriage started to fall apart in 1911, the couple moved out and eventually divorced. This renowned property is where Edith wrote many of her best sellers, and had famous friends visit, including Henry James.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Boston, Massachusetts to investigate the USS Constitution, the oldest commissioned warship still afloat in the world and one that also never lost a battle. She was built in 1794 and decommissioned in 1855, then placed in permanent commission in 1940. Today she holds a crew of 60, but at a peak time, during the War of 1812, she had 450-500 people aboard: including 60 marines, 350-400 sailors, and 50 officers/ship boys.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to North Adams, Massachusetts to investigate Houghton Mansion. It was built in 1897 for North Adams' first Mayor, A.C Houghton. Constructed on the foundation of a previous home, The Houghton Mansion was used for the family and fundraisers. The hauntings are said to have begun in 1914 after a tragic car accident took the lives of A.C Houghton and his daughter. His chauffer was driving and was so overcome with guilt that he took his own life the next day. A week later Mr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called out by two clients to investigate the Midwest Railway Preservation Society in Cleveland, Ohio. Built in 1907, this rail yard had over 400 people working there 24/7. Some of the jobs were very dangerous with a number of injuries and deaths taking place over the years, with the brakeman being one of the most dangerous. Sometimes people fell off the tops of the trains and died.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On the season premiere of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Cleveland, Ohio to investigate Grays Armory. It was built in 1893 to house the men's only Grays militia force, a force that was to protect the city of Cleveland from any unrest, as there was no National Guard at that point in time. The gray color was chosen to honor the New York grey's for being victorious during the Revolutionary War.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Detroit, Michigan to investigate The Whitney. Originally built in 1890 by lumber baron David Whitney, it was used as a private residence for him and his second wife, Sarah, along with his four children. At the time the house was built he was the wealthiest man in Detroit, and spared no expense in his home, including adding the first personal use elevator, and $400,000 worth of furnishings from two trips to Europe. Mr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Toledo, Ohio to investigate the Toledo Yacht Club. Susan Hurst has called the guys in to investigate the club, which first opened in 1865. A fire destroyed it in 1906 and it was rebuilt in 1908. It became well known during the prohibition era, as bootleggers used the docks to smuggle Canadian booze across Lake Erie.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS stays local as they investigate the Varnum Memorial Armory in East Greenwich, Rhode Island. The armory was built in 1913 by the Varnum Continentals, Inc., a group that works to preserve the Rhode Island military history, and was to be used as a clubhouse and meeting hall for them. There are no reported deaths on the property, but they did hold wakes for soldiers that died during WWI and WWII.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called in to investigate Old Lake County Jail, in Crown Pint, Indiana. Originally built in 1882, the jail had 10 cells plus the attached sheriff house, which was required by Indiana law to have the Sheriff reside next to or in front of the jail. The prison went through two expansions, the first in 1908 and the second in 1928. At its peak the jail could hold 150 prisoners.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to Valparaiso, Indiana to investigate the Inn at Aberdeen. The house dates back to the 1850's and was purchased by the Ritter family, who were thought to be involved in the Underground Railroad. The house changed ownership over the years until the client, John, purchased it in 1995. Since then reports of paranormal activity have been accumulating.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.
programme.sub-title: Give Me Liberty or Give Me Corpses

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called out to the Garde Arts Center in New London, Connecticut. The Center is the former site of the Williams Family Mansion, built in1831 by Thomas Wheeler Williams. Mr. Williams was a congressman and part of the whaling community; in a city know as the "Whaling City." Thomas Wheeler Williams married twice having a total of 9 children. Tragically 5 of Thomas's children died under the age of 22yrs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to Cornwall Bridge, Connecticut to investigate the Vogel Residence. Their client, Robin Vogel, is afraid that the Curse Of Dudleytown has spread to her home and has asked TAPS to help. Dudleytown was an abandoned settlement that dates back to the 1740's. Many people believe the settlement was cursed due to the fact that many inhabitants died a violent death or went insane. The Vogel Residence was originally built in 1780 with an addition put on in 1830.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: We are introduced to Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson, co-founders and lead investigators for The Atlantic Paranormal Society (TAPS). Their Technical Manager, Brian Harnois, tells them of an interesting case. The home they are to investigate is in Altoona, PA which is several hours away, but because of the dramatic nature of the case they decide to make the long drive. They investigate reports of poltergeist activity in a home with a very young girl who seems to see the spirits.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The team investigates the historic Mishler Theatre and the Altoona Railroaders Memorial Museum. At the theater, the owner and employees have seen the late owner walking into the wall where his old office used to be, sitting in the seats, and have heard him walking on the catwalk above the stage. At the museum, the spirit of a railroad worker has been seen. Despite some orb activity in the theater, neither site presents any good evidence of paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The team investigates The Lighthouse Inn in New London, Conn., which is reported to be haunted by the ghost of a bride who fell down a flight of stairs on her wedding day in 1930. Drops in temperature are recorded, and Steve feels someone touch him on his back when no one else is nearby. They then travel to Ashland, Mass. to a pub called Stone's Public House, formerly The Railroad House. Here, a little girl died after being hit by a train.
programme.sub-title: Lighthouse Inn and John Stone Tarvern / The Lighthouse Inn

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: At the request of the US Coast Guard, TAPS goes to Long Island Sound to investigate the Race Rock Lighthouse. The lighthouse is now automated, but the Coast Guard officers who come to do maintenance and inspection have reported strange occurrences and are nervous about going to the site. The commanding officers hope to disprove the rumors. The team's cameras pick up strange orb activity and a fog which the investigators do not remember from the time of the video.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This investigation focuses on some friends of Brian's whose home is a deconsecrated 19th century church. They claim to have seen apparitions and to have heard strange noises. Also, one of the doors in the house opens by itself. The investigation turns up only orbs caused by dust. Jason determines that the sounds and orbs are caused by the settling of the wood beams when the church bell rings. The team is able to duplicate the opening door, giving a mundane explanation.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to investigate an armory in New Bedford, Mass. In one room, the thermal imaging camera detects a warm mist passing in front of the lens. This is very strange, because mists are generally colder than the surrounding air. While moving along a catwalk, sound man Frank DeAngelis suddenly falls down and does not feel well enough to move for quite some time.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Reports of disturbances in a college student group house are easily explained as acoustics and encounters with neighbors who were drunk at the time. At the Topton House Pub, witnesses have reported that the ghost of a little girl sometimes trips people on the steps and has moved glasses of soda on one table. The daughter of the owner has also smelled roses while in the cellar and heard murmurring voices.
programme.sub-title: Fortuna Apartment, Topton House, & Frank's Interview / Fortuna & Topton

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates two cases. First they go to Albany, NY to the home of Linda Johnson. Linda claims to be psychically sensitive, and to have been accosted by a negative or ""demonic"" entity. No conclusive evidence is found, but Jason suggests that Keith Johnson contact her separately to try to help further. Next, they meet Adam Zubrowski, who seems to be experiencing strange events. The house was built by his grandparents, and his grandfather died there.
programme.sub-title: Johnson House & Zubrowski House / The Negative Entity

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS goes to New Orleans to investigate one of the "most haunted" places in the U.S., and Brian's new relationship interferes with his work causing tension with TAPS members. They capture an image on their thermal camera and discover a lamp that moves on its own. Jason and Grant both agree that the plantation is haunted.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS helps a family whose young children claim to be tormented by ghosts. They find bones under the floorboards. After further analysis, the bones are not human but animal and the footage shows that the little boy, not ghosts, is waking up his sister in the middle of the night. Then TAPS helps a young woman who is experiencing lots of paranormal activity in her home. Jason is attacked and TAPS concludes that the entity is focused on the young woman.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Brian can't go on this road trip. A training mission in North Carolina goes awry when team members get food poisoning. A local ghost hunting group asks TAPS for help with a haunted battleship. Jason and Grant are chased through the bowels of the ship. There are a lot of personal experiences but the team fails to capture anything on tape. The results are inconclusive.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Brian asks Jason and Grant for some time off. TAPS visits a local playhouse with a long history of hauntings but their investigation doesn't yield any evidence. Then they head over to a firehouse where the paranormal activity is spooking some of the volunteer firemen. Jason and Grant have an odd experience with a stereo that turns itself on. Andy tries to debunk some alarms that get tripped on their own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Brian leaves TAPS. Andy persuades Jason and Grant to investigate a haunted lighthouse. Steve and Andy experience a cold spot but nothing else happens. Jason and Grant tell Andy he should be more diligent with his case studies. TAPS travel to New York for a haunted museum. Andy gets in a tiff with the other members. The team doesn't capture any evidence of a haunting.
programme.sub-title: New London Lighthouse & Merchant's House Museum

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS searches for paranormal evidence at a lavish historical estate in Rhode Island. They debunk the cold spots in the basement when they find a blocked heating system. programme.title: Ghost Hunters

They head to Massachusetts and investigate the former home of the infamous Lizzie Borden who was accused of viciously murdering her father and step-mother with an axe.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Kentucky to investigate one of the most haunted places in the country, Waverly Hills Sanatorium. Over two nights of extensive investigation, the members of TAPS have a variety of inexplicable encounters and eerie personal experiences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS answers an urgent call from a homeowner in Clinton, Massachusetts, who is being plagued by a disturbing spirit. programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A frightened family in Glen Gardner, New Jersey calls TAPS for assistance from a menacing shadowy figure that is haunting their home. programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Florida to investigate the paranormal activities at the historical St. Augustine Lighthouse. programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Guthrie, Oklahoma to investigate The Stone Lion Inn, a bed and breakfast experiencing paranormal phenomenon. programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A battle of the sexes which has raged in Broughton since the First World War comes to a head when ageing feminist Mildred Danvers is found dead after returning to her childhood home. programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When council clerk Martin Barrett is shot dead, Barnaby and Jones discover that he was an expert blackmailer. They investigate which of his victims hated him enough to kill him, and the trail leads to Fennacombe Bay. Why are Richard and Maggie Florian spending so much time at sea, and could police committee chairman Sir John Waverley have a scandalous past? With the help of Barnaby, they intend to find out.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Controversial plans to build a supermarket in Elverton-cum-Latterly lead to murder when a man is stabbed to death and the pollution advisor for the site seems to be spending more time with the women of the village than at work. Can Barnaby and Jones discover the truth and learn what is really polluting Elverton?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Midsomer Worthy's baritone Connor Simpson is killed just days before a competition, the rest of the choir, including Joyce Barnaby, are in fear for their lives. Barnaby and Jones investigate and find an atmosphere of bitter rivalry and tense marital relationships. Then, there's another murder and the race is on to catch the killer before the choral showdown.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby begins to question the guilt of a Midsomer Malham woman who is on trial for the murder of her best friend. The evidence is stacked against her, but she doesn't appear deluded or obsessed with the dead woman's husband as the prosecution claim. With the help of a frail pensioner - the key witness, can Barnaby and Jones discover what really happened on the night of the murder?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the body of a young man is found in a WWII-era motor car full of exhaust fumes, it looks like suicide. However, Simon Bright was not alone - as he was hit on the head before he died. Where is his girlfriend, newcomer Laura Sharp? What is her hold on the people of Morton Fendle, a village still overshadowed by the gloomy spectre of the war?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Faith Alexander arrives in Midsomer Deverell to meet her long lost uncle Rex Masters, she is surprised to find that he has disappeared and that he had told everyone that she was killed in a plane crash. Then Rex's body is found in the weir, and his friends produce wills, each claiming to inherit his fortune, but what is the truth about Rex's life of mischief-making, and who wanted him dead?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A glassware factory in Midsomer Magna faces ruin after the death of its co-owner Alan King. His widow Hilary angers her son Ian by marrying Alan's brother Charles, and rumours begin to circulate that Charles and accountant Peter Baxter have embezzled funds. When Peter is stabbed to death with a Masonic dagger and Ian starts behaving strangely, Barnaby is called.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When old rock band Hired Gun re-form to play a gig at the Midsomer Rocks Festival, paranoid lead singer Gary Cooper is convinced that someone is trying to scare them off and stop the reunion. Firstly, rock diva Mimi Clifton is electrocuted on stage, then drummer Nicky Harding is found dead in his swimming pool. Barnaby has to face the possibility that one of his heroes is a murderer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a photo of DCI Barnaby with another woman is displayed shortly before her estranged husband is murdered, he becomes a prime suspect in the crime. To make matters worse, it appears that Barnaby visited the victim on the night he died, and a glass with his fingerprints on it is found at the dead man's home. As the evidence begins to mount up against him, will Barnaby be able to clear his name?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Dr Alan Delaney is killed by a hit-and-run driver, Barnaby realises that the real target was Delaney's senior partner, Dr James Kirkwood. Is the killer trying to prevent James from marrying beautiful divorcee Delyth Mostyn? How is the death linked to the £30,000 which is missing from the surgery account?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Nick Cheyney, director of a new film of `The Scarlet Pimpernel' is beheaded by a guillotine on set, there is no shortage of suspects. An actor whose career he has ruined, a woman who bore his child after a drunken one-night stand, and an embittered gay, alcoholic extra all have grudges against him. Medical evidence then shows that Cheyney was drugged with morphine. Can Barnaby and Jones find the killer?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When an old colleague of DCI Barnaby's is found murdered, a sex scandal at Causton police station 16 years previously comes back to haunt him. His investigation takes him to Midsomer Holm, a halfway house for ex-prisoners founded by Lord Holm, a man who also served time for the murder of his wife. As they try to find links between the suspects and a seedy group known as the Friday Nighters, another person goes missing.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: There are two contrasting weddings taking place in Midsomer - Cully's to Simon, and local baronet Ned Fitzroy's to Beth Porteous. As Cully suffers from last minute doubts, Barnaby becomes an unwelcome guest at Ned's marriage when the maid of honour is stabbed to death. What are the secrets in Midsomer high society, and will Barnaby get to his daughter's ceremony on time?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A family feud dating back to WWI comes to a head after the unveiling of a war memorial in Midsomer Parva, when a retired colonel is found dead. During their investigation, Barnaby and Jones discover that the town's mayor blamed the deceased man for his grandfather's shooting for cowardice at the Somme, and that the dysfunctional families are connected by dangerous secrets.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A reclusive couple are found dead, victims of a supposedly botched burglary which shocks the occupants of the village of Dunstan. Then, a guest is murdered at the wedding at one of Jones' oldest friends. Could this spate of killings be connected to a mystery of a fatal road accident, and the disappearance of a teenager 20 years ago?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a body is discovered in woodland near Midsomer Sonning, country magazine Midsomer Life and its outspoken owner Guy Sandys come under scrutiny from Barnaby and Jones. Former city fund manager Guy is disliked in the neighbourhood for his negative reviews of local businesses. The body proves to be that of a man with whom Guy's wife was having an affair. Then Guy himself is found stabbed through the heart.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a pub landlady is crushed to death during a magic show in Midsomer Oaks, Barnaby and Nelson uncover conflict between the village church and ancient pagan traditions. Is famous magician Gideon Latimer to blame or is he the target?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones are called away from a hated team-building exercise to investigate an explosion at a haulage yard run by Territorial Army officer Matt Parkes and his ruthless son James. James is involved in some shady activities, but is he capable of arson or murder? When a body turns up, there are plenty of other suspects on the scene, including a peace protestor and a host of trained killers at the TA.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Two couples vanish without trace from the village of Monks Barton amid rumours of witchcraft and haunted woods. Flamboyant psychic Cyrus LeVanu clashes with pompous cleric Wallace Stone as a body is found, while other villagers seem to be caught up in a stolen antiques racket.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The peaceful setting of prestigious Whiteoaks Golf Club is rocked by death and controversy when a golfer is bludgeoned to death near the notorious 13th hole known as Crisp's Folly. Barnaby and Jones discover gambling is rife at the club - along with illegal money-lending and violent assault. Then, as the club considers giving ordinary villagers full membership rights, another golfer is killed.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby finds a tangled world of crime and intrigue in the art world. A recently discovered masterpiece by local artist Henry Hogson realises an impressive price at auction just hours before its previous owner is tortured and killed. Can Barnaby and Jones prevent the body count from rising further?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby's secret past as a spy is revealed when a former agent is found dead after a cricket match in Midsomer Parva. While locals blame the brutal killing on the `beast of Midsomer', Barnaby suspects otherwise. He soon finds links to a network of spies that operated in Cold War Berlin, but his investigation is obstructed at every turn.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Science fellow George Jeffers threatens to go public with what he believes is a potentially lethal software glitch in a new air traffic control system. American software boss Clinton Finn fears he will lose millions if the truth comes out and puts pressure on the University authorities, but when village schoolteacher Emily Harte is killed by a hit-and-run driver, Barnaby wonders if Jeffers was the real target.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The peace of Little Worthy is shattered by a bizarre murder when a man is found stabbed and tied down like Gulliver in Lilliput in the sleepy hamlet's model village. Barnaby and Jones are called in, and they find many secrets hidden behind the traditions, tourist attractions and tea rooms. Then, the killer strikes again. Can the detectives discover the truth about the residents of Little Worthy and solve the crimes?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A burglar known as `the Creeper' terrorises Midsomer as Barnaby and Jones investigate the murder of a dinner party guest at upper-crust Chettham Park House. The detectives discover a group of high society friends with links both to gangsters and the Chief Constable dating back to the 1960s, but do the friends also have secrets worth killing for?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Schoolteacher Connie Bishop keeps waking in the night, convinced she has an intruder. Just days later a local councillor, said to be obsessed with her, is found murdered in her garden. Is Connie the innocent victim she seems? Barnaby and Jones uncover jealous rivals, ruthless social climbers and a cottage with secrets as they search for the killer in Badger's Drift.

programme.title: Humpday
programme.desc: Two college buddies reunite after a decade apart. Ben (Mark Duplass) is married and planning to start a family; Andrew (Joshua Leonard), a free spirit, has spent the last 10 years traveling the globe. Reigniting the rivalries of their college years, the friends agree to enter a movie in an upcoming amateur porn festival. Ben and Andrew's constant need to one-up each other results in a daring proposition: The staunchly heterosexual friends must star together in a gay adult film.

programme.title: Goon

programme.title: Skate Kitchen

programme.title: Shaolin Red Master
programme.desc: Left at the Shaolin Temple after the murder of his parents, the kid learns well the fighting skills of the monks. At the peak of his study, he learns about the circumstances of his parents death and goes to seek the identity of the killer.

programme.title: Mars Villa aka Wu Tang Magic Kick
programme.desc: John Liu and Phillip Ko star. Mar Tien Liang is the master of the Magic Kick. When his home is attacked by the Fang Kang he effortlessly defeats his opponent, but his wife Mar Tien Liang is horrified to witness such violence. She implores him never to use his magic kick again, and all is well, until Fang arrives to challenge the master.

programme.title: Magnificent Chivalry
programme.desc: Hong Kong superstar Jimmy "One Arm Boxer" Wang Yu stars as the Bamboo blade, China's top swordsman. His services are rendered by the Imperial treasury, who wants him to infiltrate a powerful gang of Highwaymen and get back the stolen silver bullion. After numerous deadly encounters the gang is beaten by the bamboo sword and only the gang leader remains; however he's a lot tougher than they originally bargained for.

programme.title: Kung Fu from Beyond the Grave
programme.desc: Rare Billy film! Watch him fight Lo Lieh and demons! On the 7th month of the lunar calendar, all ghosts and spirits are active and get to walk the earth for a month so that they can find a way to reincarnate. During one of these nights, a young kid named Chun Sing (Billy Chong), is visited by his dead Father. Chun Sing's father states that he was murdered by a man named Kam Tai Fu (Lo Lieh). And as you may have guessed, Chun Sing must avenge his father's death.

programme.title: The Revenger
programme.desc: TI LUNG stars as the Kung Fu warrior Shao Tu, dedicated to help the oppressed, but who makes many deadly enemies along the way. One of which is Mao (Wong Ching) who with his army of fighters hatches a deadly plot to bring about the downfall of Shao Tu.

programme.title: Eagle vs Silver Fox
programme.desc: After the downfall of the Manchu Dynasty, the surviving officials plan to restore order across China. One of these men, Silver Fox, hires the best fighters in the country to assassinate those who were responsible for the revolution and destroy all martial arts schools. To combat this menace the various schools band together and nominate Chow Fung, master of the Eagle form, to face the might of the Silver Fox in a one-on-one bone-breaking showdown.

programme.title: Dragon and Snake in the Spider's Web
programme.desc: Security Officer Lu (Tan Tao Liang) is following a case of a mysterious gun smuggler. His investigations lead him to Madam Wu, who appears to be the link between smuggler and client. Luckily for Lu, Wu seems to have a soft spot for the womanizing gambler known as Chang (Wong Tao) so Lu arrests him in the hope that, with a little brute force, he will assist in the case.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub
programme.desc: "The lone wolf goes deep undercover in a corrupt prison to solve a murder that happened two years ago."

programme.title: Hell's Wind Staff
programme.desc: Kung fu super villain, Hwang Jang-Lee (known among fans as "Silver Fox,") is the main attraction in this brilliant kung fu flick, which was reportedly adapted from a comic book. Impudent but likeable kung fu students Tiger Wong (Meng Yuen Man) and Stone Dragon (Meng Hoi) have the potential to be great fighters but seem more interested in driving their teachers to distraction.

programme.title: The Invincible
programme.desc: The infamous "Red Dragon" and his Mongolian counterparts invade China and massacre countless people. The situation looks terrible but then a hero emerges who wants to defy the Red Dragon; Li Mu-Bai (Wang Yu), the Invincible!

programme.title: The Eagle Fist
programme.desc: A young militia fighter decides to throw in his lot and go off and learns kung fu. He meets a master of the Eagle fist and soon becomes a master, as well as learning some dark truths about his teacher's past and why he was trained to such a high level.

programme.title: The Invincible

programme.title: Mean Streets of Kung Fu
programme.desc: When challenged by a local gangster, a top martial arts student (Barry Chan) proves his skill and determination and defeats the thug. Now it's open warfare and fierce battles between the forces of good and evil.

programme.title: Eagle vs Silver Fox

programme.title: Eagle Claws Champion
programme.desc: Unruly Eagle's Claw champion Kim goes through a series of tough life challenges after mistakenly killing his opponent, Wu's brother. With Wu on this trail he must get his life together and perfect his technique in order to survive the inevitable showdown against the mighty tiger fists.

programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don looks ahead to the long Easter weekend by cutting back his grass borders. programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don shows us how to plant pots of bulbs for fabulous summer colour. Meanwhile, Carol Klein is out and about looking at native celandines, Wordsworth's favourite flower. They grace our hedgerows and woods at this time of year. The wild strains are too invasive for most domestic gardens, but Carol finds a number of cultivated varieties that should suit most of us.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don is at RHS Garden Wisley in Surrey to learn from the experts there how easy alpines are to grow, which seeds are needed to plant a wildflower meadow and the best orchids to grow for each room in the house. Meanwhile, Carol Klein helps Britain in Bloom volunteer Michael Welsh, who is determined to bring colour to the former colliery town of Easington with a community garden.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don searches for signs of spring in his garden at Longmeadow. Taking inspiration from his trip to RHS Garden Wisley, he plants up an alpine trough. Meanwhile, Carol Klein looks at native celandines which grace hedgerows and woods at this time of year.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don plants a vine to grow dessert grapes and looks at varieties that can be grown outside as well as in a greenhouse. Meanwhile, Carol Klein is at home in Glebe Cottage where she reveals a little of the fascinating history of one of our spring favourites, Trillium grandiflorum. Plus, Rachel de Thame explores a suburban, hidden garden with charms all of its own.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don, Joe Swift and Carol Klein go behind the scenes at the Malvern Spring Gardening Show. While Monty takes a sneak peak at the floral marquee before the show opens, Carol hunts for rare and unusual plants.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: The programme comes from all four of the Royal Horticultural Society gardens, where the team are out on the road exploring how each location's differing climate affects the plants they grow. Carol Klein broadcasts from Wisley in Surrey. In the garden at Harlow Carr in Yorkshire, Joe Swift gets plenty of propagating tips. Rachel de Thame explores the gardens at Hyde Hall in Essex, and Monty Don visits Rosemoor in Devon.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As the winter draws to a close, work in the garden starts to step up gear. He also reveals plans for reinvigorating the area in his garden where perennials are planted. Plus, Carol Klein visits Glendurgan Garden in Cornwall.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty tackles three seasons of gardening when he makes additions to his spring garden, gives advice on how to dry and preserve herbs for winter and plants up a container to give interest from now until spring. Carol celebrates one of the plant successes of an extraordinary summer, the Canna while Frances Tophill tackles a viewer's garden and suggests plants which will perform throughout the winter. Toby Buckland visits a garden in Devon with Japanese influences.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don is back at the helm, but this time in the garden at his own Herefordshire home - a place that he has lovingly nurtured for the last 20 years. With winter receding, Monty, Carol Klein, Joe Swift and Rachel de Thame are preparing for spring. As well as showing us round his garden, Monty lifts and divides snowdrops and sows beetroot and plants onions. Monty also prunes his apple trees and trims his shrub roses.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty helps two families create dream gardens that are as much for the children as for the adults. In Doncaster, Nikki and John want a garden full of edible plants and fruit.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty faces some of the most surprising plans yet - a Norwegian garden complete with waterfalls to be fashioned out of a tiny back yard in Dorset, and nothing less than a Japanese tea garden to be created out of a patch of ground in Bromley.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty Don is asked to rescue two nightmare outside spaces. In Salisbury, newly engaged Glenn and Zoe want a brand new garden and most of all they are desperate to produce flowers for their wedding. Currently their steeply sloping garden is completely unusable.

programme.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens
programme.desc: Monty continues his travels to learn about the art of Japanese stonemasonry and the famous tea ceremonies and their accompanying gardens, before finally taking a lesson in the delicate art of traditional flower arranging.

programme.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don returns to Japan during the fiery blaze of autumn. He visits the three great gardens of Japan to learn how they protect the garden from the coming winter and learns how the Japanese are weaving nature into their concrete urban jungle.

programme.title: Monty Don's French Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don visits some of the most famous and interesting gardens in France. Here, he tells the stories behind France's important historic gardens. These include elaborate walled gardens designed to please the mistress - and then the wife - of a King, and magnificent displays of flowers and fountains that involved thousands of soldiers moving tracts of land and incited violent jealousy in another monarch.

programme.title: Monty Don's French Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don turns to the French love of food and finds out how this has influenced their gardens. He travels to some of the most famous `potager' or kitchen gardens, where vegetables and flowers are planted together in elaborate and beautiful displays. He also talks to gardeners about this style of planting which has been copied the world over.

programme.title: Monty Don's French Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels to some of the most celebrated artists' gardens, including the one created by the impressionist Claude Monet, who planted and painted his garden for half his life. Monty also matches the paintings to the garden of Paul Cezanne, as well as visiting several contemporary artistic gardens to see how the use of plants and trees has evolved into new and varied styles.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

programme.title: The High Road With Keith Warren
programme.desc: On this episode of The High Road with Keith Warren, Keith heads out to his favorite place to hunt massive whitetail, the Legends Ranch in Bitely, Michigan. Keith goes on a mission to dispatch a mangled buck that was absolutely wrecked in a fight.

programme.title: Ted Nugent Spirit Of The Wild
programme.desc: Ted hunts SpiritWild Ranch with his Mathews bow and takes a buck with a surprise drop tine. Shemane has a special message for new bowhunters.

programme.title: Game On With Blaine Anthony
programme.desc: Blaine is in New Brunswick after a bear that has eluded him for 6 years.

programme.title: Mark Peterson's The Journey Within
programme.desc: This episode goes beyond the hunt to reveal what it really takes to build something lasting in the world of guiding. It's not about one person-it's about the right people, showing up at the right time, all putting in the work to make it happen.
programme.sub-title: The Guides- Life of an Outfitter: What It Takes To Start A Legacy

programme.title: Dean Partridge's Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: Magnus Partridge hunts a GIANT Droptine full velvet dream buck with his Darton Bow!

programme.title: Pursue The Wild
programme.desc: In this episode we travel into the backcountry on a pack trip with a group of ladies.

programme.title: For Love Or Likes
programme.desc: Things start to get heated as girls check trail cams and jealousy of daytime bucks start to set in. A competition with a twist causes chaos as girls compete to steal the best hunt zone and the first buck steps into shooting on the second evening.

programme.title: Yamaha Adventure Flim Series
programme.desc: From conquering the unforgiving granite of the Rubicon Trail to battling the mud and chaos of the Ironman GNCC, Yamaha's Proven Off-Road machines show what they're made of. The RMAX 1000 traverses one of the most rugged trails in North America.
programme.sub-title: Trail Tested, Race Proven: Wolverine RMAX 1000 & YFZ450R in Action

programme.title: Own The Season Tv
programme.desc: Two Own The Season TV team members head to the turkey woods with their youth family members in hopes of tagging a spring Wisconsin gobbler.
Follow the founders: Joe Miles / Asio Gear and Andrae D'Acquisto / Lone Wolf Custom Gear as they hunt big bucks in Iowa, Texas and Mexico!

programme.title: Just Kill'n Time TV
programme.desc: Join Buck as he heads to Missouri to archery hunt whitetails.

programme.title: The Bearded Buck
programme.desc: After Austins target deer goes MIA he switches gears back to the home farm to chase a local legend they call Nixon. This deer is a 6.5 year old PA giant.

programme.title: Weird Hunts
programme.desc: Using two full mount buck decoys, Matt wants to shoot a mature buck that is coming in to the deer puppets fighting. He then heads to Iowa to role play as a civil war soldier hunting down a turkey with a musket.

programme.title: Cabela's Deer Gear
programme.desc: We're back in the field with TenPoint Crossbows - the leader in crossbow technology - as we're on the quest for learning more about their latest and greatest, harvesting some Texas whiteteail, and more.

programme.title: Mojo Untamed
programme.desc: With an eye popping display of massive flocks of waterfowl, Terry finds himself hunting on Cloud 9.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Cosmology takes the entire universe as its subject, not just its form, structure and contents, but also the manner of its birth and evolution; looking at the origin of cosmology in creation stories and its relation to the journey ahead.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Introducing the hierarchy of structures in the universe; from planets to stars, galaxies, galaxy clusters and larger groupings of galaxies called the cosmic web; light travels at a finite speed, looking far away also means looking far back in time.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Discussing cosmic properties; the universe is lumpy at the scale of galaxies and galaxy clusters; at larger scales, it is smooth and similar in all directions; this property of homogeneity and isotropy is called the cosmological principle.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: The most familiar constituents of the universe are atomic matter and light; neutrinos make up another component; 96 percent of the universe is dark energy and dark matter; the relative amounts of these constituents changes as the universe expands.

programme.title: The Origin and Evolution of Earth: From the Big Bang to the Future of Human Existence
programme.desc: Beginning the study of Earth's history by voyaging backward in time; seeing how each crucial stage in the evolution of the planet depends on what comes before; previewing the role played by minerals, which coevolves with life.
programme.sub-title: Mineralogy and a New View of Earth

programme.title: The Origin and Evolution of Earth: From the Big Bang to the Future of Human Existence
programme.desc: Earth exists for only a third of the history of the universe; what happens before the planet forms; journeying back to the Big Bang; how fundamental forces and particles freeze out of a homogeneous state in the initial moments of cosmic evolution.
programme.sub-title: Origin and Evolution of the Early Universe

programme.title: The Origin and Evolution of Earth: From the Big Bang to the Future of Human Existence
programme.desc: How simple atoms of hydrogen and helium make stars; how stars manufacture all other naturally occurring elements through processes including titanic supernova explosions; nucleosynthesis is responsible for the chemical richness behind Earth.

programme.title: The Origin and Evolution of Earth: From the Big Bang to the Future of Human Existence
programme.desc: Tracing the origin of minerals; discovering a candidate for the first crystal forged in the cauldron of dying stars; following the processes that create other early minerals, which survive in their original form in microscopic presolar dust grains.
programme.sub-title: Ur-Minerals, First Crystals in the Cosmos

programme.title: The Return of the Musketeers
programme.desc: When ambitious Oliver Cromwell (Alan Howard) overthrows the king, Cardinal Mazarin (Philippe Noiret) enlists a down-and-out D'Artagnan (Michael York) to rally the Musketeers against him. Porthos (Frank Finlay) accepts at once, but Athos (Oliver Reed) and Aramis (Richard Chamberlain) are reluctant. Still, the three reunite, but they are soon torn apart by infighting. They get a chance at redemption when they are sent to England to save the life of King Charles I (Bill Paterson).

programme.title: Dudley Do-Right
programme.desc: Based on the cartoon, this live-action comedy follows the adventures of Dudley Do-Right (Brendan Fraser), an enthusiastic, if somewhat dim, Canadian Mountie. When Dudley's childhood crush, Nell Fenwick (Sarah Jessica Parker), returns to their hometown in the mountains, he is eager to spend time with her, but his attempts at courting her are foiled by the villainous Snidely Whiplash (Alfred Molina), who is up to his usual schemes. Can Dudley win Nell's heart and curtail Snidely's wicked ways?

programme.title: Peter Pan
programme.desc: As Wendy Darling (Rachel Hurd-Wood) recounts stories to her brothers, John (Harry Newell) and Michael (Freddie Popplewell), she is visited by Peter Pan (Jeremy Sumpter). Peter, a boy who magically never ages, invites Wendy and her brothers to Neverland, an island where he lives with the Lost Boys. Once there, however, Wendy and her brothers are kidnapped by Captain Hook (Jason Isaacs). Peter, with assistance from the fairy Tink (Ludivine Sagnier), must face Hook in order to rescue the Darlings.

programme.title: The Perfect Man
programme.desc: Every time Jean (Heather Locklear) goes through a bad breakup, she moves her two daughters elsewhere. Determined to make a home in New York, their latest destination, eldest daughter Holly (Hilary Duff) creates a fake online secret admirer for her mother, based on her friend's uncle. But as the "romance" develops, Holly encounters obstacles as her mom falls for the lie. Meanwhile, Holly has found her own love interest this time around in her cute classmate Adam (Ben Feldman).

programme.title: My Adventures with Santa
programme.desc: Instead of a joyous family gathering, the Nolans are spending this holiday apart. On a last minute shopping trip with Dad, the family enters an enchanted store only to discover a dazzling snow globe with magical powers.

programme.title: Heartbeeps
programme.desc: While at the repair factory, Val (Andy Kaufman), a robot valet, meets Aqua (Bernadette Peters), a fellow automaton who functions as a party hostess. Remarkably, the two robots discover that they are in love, and impulsively flee from their duties. Looking for a place where they can establish a home, Val and Aqua create their own mechanized child, but their happiness is short-lived, since a relentless enforcer robot has been programmed to apprehend them.

programme.title: North Shore
programme.desc: After learning how to surf by using the local wave tanks, Arizona resident Rick (Matt Adler) uses his winnings from a recent contest to fly to Hawaii and try to make a living for himself as a professional wave rider. He gets off to a rough start, as he finds riding the ocean a lot different than the simulated waves back home, but he soon finds a mentor in the aging surf guru Chandler (Gregory Harrison) and a friend in local girl Kiani (Nia Peeples).

programme.title: Lily in Winter
programme.desc: New Yorkers report the kidnapping of their son (Brian Bonsall) who follows his nanny (Natalie Cole) on a train taking her home to 1957 Alabama.

programme.title: Dragonfly
programme.desc: When a loved one dies, are they gone forever? As head of emergency services for Chicago Memorial Hospital, Dr. Joe Darrow (Kevin Costner) is a respected expert in trauma and triage. But his professional knowledge provides little comfort when tragedy claims the life of his wife. A doctor herself, Emily Darrow (Susanna Thompson) was on a medical mercy mission when she died in a bus accident on a remote mountain road in Venezuela. Joe starts believing his wife is trying to communicate with him.

programme.title: Prime
programme.desc: Rafi Gardet (Uma Thurman) is a 37-year-old divorced Catholic businesswoman falling for David (Bryan Greenberg), a 23-year-old Jewish artist. With the help of her therapist, Dr. Lisa Metzger (Meryl Streep), Rafi tries to overcome her insecurities and accept the age difference between her and David. But when Lisa learns more about her client's new love, she realizes that David is her son. As Lisa tries to separate the couple, Rafi and David fear that they may not be right for each other after all.

He gets off to a rough start, as he finds riding the ocean a lot different than the simulated waves back home, but he soon finds a mentor in the aging surf guru Chandler (Gregory Harrison) and a friend in local girl Kiani (Nia Peeples).

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: Head Over Heels
programme.desc: Although she has an excellent job at the Metropolitan Museum of Art and a fabulous apartment with model roommates, New Yorker Amanda Pierce (Monica Potter) remains unlucky in love and intent on finding the right guy. When she develops a crush on neighbor Jim Winston (Freddie Prinze Jr.), she begins to spy on him and witnesses his apparent involvement in a murder. Since things don't add up, she tries to figure out what really happened -- and if she still has a shot at dating the guy.

programme.title: American Pie Presents: Beta House
programme.desc: Freshman Erik Stifler (John White) arrives at college with his longtime friend "Cooze" Coozeman (Jake Siegel). Both freshmen pledge the Beta fraternity and begin a series of often disgusting initiation rituals, climaxing with stealing an object from the house of their rivals, the Geek fraternity. The furious Geek president, Edgar Willis (Tyrone Savage), challenges the Betas to the Greek Games -- a competition that's been banned on campus for 40 years.

programme.title: American Pie Presents: The Book of Love
programme.desc: Three high-school buddies (Bug Hall, Kevin M. Horton) use a legendary sex manual to lose their virginity.

programme.title: Ali G Indahouse
programme.desc: Ali G, the U.K.'s hottest comic sensation, makes his way to American audiences with "Ali G Indahouse." In his big-screen debut, the chilled-out, hip-hopping, white gangsta-rapper wannabe finds himself in the bizarre position of having to resolve one of Great Britain's biggest national and political scandals. Abetted by his loyal crew, the West Staines Massive and long-suffering girlfriend Me Julie, he emerges as the unlikeliest of heroes.

programme.title: Wet Hot American Summer
programme.desc: Set on the last day of camp, in the hot summer of 1981, "Wet Hot American Summer" follows a group of counselors who are each trying to complete their unfinished business before the day ends. The entire summer of pent-up sexual frustrations, unresolved post-traumatic stress, pending separations and of course, the talent show, all weigh heavily on the minds and groins of counselors and campers alike.

Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: Cops Reloaded
programme.desc: "Cops" has been producing new episodes for more than 20 years, and with daily repeats of the iconic series entering their second decade on the air, producers felt it was time for a change to freshen things up, which is how the idea for "Cops Reloaded" was born. This entry in the long-running franchise takes footage from previous episodes and re-edits it to produce new episodes. Some of the program's wildest criminals, most memorable car chases, and craziest moments are featured on "Reloaded."

programme.title: Saint Ange
programme.desc: Anna (Virginie Ledoyen) is a cleaning woman who accepts a post at the St. Ange Orphanage. She arrives to confront an unsettling lack of orphans, save for one (Lou Doillon) who acts far too childish for her age. Then the bizarre sights and sounds begin, which seem to elude detection by the only other servant (Dorina Lazar) or the gloomy institution's director (Catriona MacColl). Is this all in Anna's mind? Or does something more sinister lurk in the heart of St. Ange?

programme.title: Session 9
programme.desc: A tale of terror when a group of asbestos removal workers start work in an abandoned insane asylum. The complex of buildings looms up out of the woods like a dormant beast. Grand, imposing ... abandoned, deteriorating. The residents of Danvers, Massachusetts steer well clear of the place. But Danvers State Mental Hospital, closed down for 15 years, is about to receive five new visitors...

programme.title: SiREN
programme.desc: One week before his wedding day, Jonah and his groomsmen hit the town for a wild night of club hopping and debauchery. The night soon takes a twisted turn for the worse when the group is invited to a seedy underground club. After Jonah frees a seemingly imprisoned dancer, he realizes that the woman he released is actually a terrifying, legendary creature that will stop at nothing to claim her prey.

programme.title: The Skulls
programme.desc: For Luke McNamara (Joshua Jackson), an invitation to join the prestigious secret college organization, The Skulls, is a dream come true. But he soon comes to realize just how powerful The Skulls organization really is -- and that the truth, like success, comes at a very high price.

programme.title: The Skulls II
programme.desc: The Skulls, a secret college society whose influence reaches the highest levels of government and business, recruits Ryan Sommers (Robin Dunne), whose future success now seems all but assured. Then one day he sees one of his fraternity brothers kill a young woman -- a crime that Ryan must keep secret if he is to remain a Skull. While Kelly (Lindy Booth), a good friend, pushes him to follow his conscience, Ryan's girlfriend, Ali (Ashley Lyn Cafagna), surprises him by being against his snitching.

programme.title: The Skulls III
programme.desc: In this sequel, beautiful and determined college student Taylor Brooks (Clare Kramer) is intent on joining the secret society known as the Skulls, despite its history of being an organization consisting solely of men. Although she encounters strong resistance, Taylor takes steps toward being accepted into their ranks, but her efforts are derailed when her boyfriend is found dead. Taylor is considered the prime suspect. Can she clear her name and track down the real murderer?

programme.title: The Spider Woman Strikes Back
programme.desc: She (Gale Sondergaard) and her hulking servant grow bloodsucking plants, as a young woman (Brenda Joyce) finds out.

programme.title: Stephanie
programme.desc: A young girl is left alone in her house during a worldwide catastrophe and fearfully hides from a malevolent force that is stalking her. When her parents miraculously return, they try to settle back into normal life, but become increasingly concerned about something that has affected their daughter Stephanie.

programme.title: Virus
programme.desc: Caught in a typhoon, a tugboat commanded by Robert Everton (Donald Sutherland) comes across a mysterious near-deserted ship. Excited to find a vessel that could be sold for as much as $30 million, Everton and his crew board and prepare to move the craft, despite the warnings of sole survivor Nadia Vinogradiya (Joanna Pacula). When a malevolent alien presence begins killing off the crew, navigator Kit Foster (Jamie Lee Curtis) tries to convince the rest of them to leave before it's too late.

programme.title: Visions
programme.desc: After moving to a vineyard with her family, a pregnant woman experiences horrifying visions.

programme.title: Wer
programme.desc: In France, an American female attorney (A.J. Cook) defends a murder suspect who has a brutish appearance and a deadly secret.

programme.title: White Noise 2: The Light
programme.desc: A man's family is killed, but he survives -- barely. After recovering, he realizes that he has changed in some way: He now senses when someone is about to die. In his attempts to save people who are near death, he discovers there is a price to pay for interfering with the cosmos.

programme.title: The Wilding
programme.desc: A family tries to start over following a daughter's release from a mental health institution.

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet Dr. Jekyll & Mr. Hyde
programme.desc: Policemen Slim (Bud Abbott) and Tubby (Lou Costello) go to London and meet a doctor (Boris Karloff) and his evil alter ego.

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein
programme.desc: In the first of Bud Abbott and Lou Costello's horror vehicles for Universal Pictures, the inimitable comic duo star as railway baggage handlers in northern Florida. When a pair of crates belonging to a house of horrors museum are mishandled by Wilbur (Lou Costello), the museum's director, Mr. MacDougal (Frank Ferguson), demands that they deliver them personally so that they can be inspected for insurance purposes, but Lou's friend Chick (Bud Abbott) has grave suspicions.

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet the Invisible Man
programme.desc: Two detective-school graduates (Bud Abbott, Lou Costello) help a framed boxer who can make himself disappear.

programme.title: Abbott and Costello Meet the Killer, Boris Karloff

Meanwhile, the Monster (Boris Karloff) remains on the run from those who wish to destroy him without understanding that his intentions are generally good despite his lack of socialization and self-control.

programme.title: The Brides of Dracula

programme.title: The Car

Sheriff Wade Parents (James Brolin) is called in to investigate, and his deputy, Everett (John Marley), is killed by the black sedan, which, some witnesses say, has no one behind its wheel. When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren (Kathleen Lloyd), are endangered.

programme.title: Creature From the Black Lagoon

To accomplish their goal, the scientists (Antonio Moreno, Richard Carlson, Richard Denning, Whit Bissell) must brave the most perilous pieces of land South America has to offer. But the terrain is nothing compared to the danger posed by an otherworldly being that endangers their work and their lives.

programme.title: The Creature Walks Among Us

programme.title: The Curse of the Werewolf

When he leaves Don Alfredo to find work, Leon discovers that he has increasingly violent urges. Although these tendencies are calmed by Leon's love for the beautiful Christina (Catherine Feller), he ultimately cannot contain his curse and transforms into a werewolf, terrorizing the Spanish countryside.

programme.title: Divergent
programme.desc: Tris Prior (Shailene Woodley) lives in a futuristic world in which society is divided into five factions. As each person enters adulthood, he or she must choose a faction and commit to it for life. Tris chooses Dauntless -- those who pursue bravery above all else. However, her initiation leads to the discovery that she is a Divergent and will never be able to fit into just one faction. Warned that she must conceal her status, Tris uncovers a looming war which threatens everyone she loves.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Insurgent
programme.desc: Now on the run from Jeanine (Kate Winslet) and the rest of the power-hungry Erudites, Tris (Shailene Woodley) and Four (Theo James) search for allies and answers in the ruins of Chicago. They must find out what Tris' family sacrificed their lives to protect and why the Erudites will do anything to stop them. Side by side, Tris and Four face one seemingly insurmountable challenge after another, as they unravel the secrets of the past and -- ultimately -- the future of their world.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Allegiant
programme.desc: Tris (Shailene Woodley) escapes with Four (Theo James) to journey beyond the wall that encloses Chicago. For the first time, they leave the only city and family they have ever known to find a peaceful solution. Once outside, they learn shocking new truths that render old discoveries meaningless. As the ruthless battle threatens humanity, Tris and Four quickly decide who to trust to survive. Tris must ultimately make difficult choices about courage, allegiance, sacrifice and love.

programme.title: The Giver
programme.desc: Jonas (Brenton Thwaites) lives in a seemingly idyllic world of conformity and contentment. When he begins to spend time with The Giver (Jeff Bridges), an old man who is the sole keeper of the community's memories, Jonas discovers the dangerous truths of his community's secret past. Armed with the power of knowledge, Jonas realizes that he must escape from their world to protect himself and those he loves -- a challenge no one has ever completed successfully.

programme.title: Milagro en el Barrio
programme.desc: Un niño ciego y el hijo de una rica familia se hacen amigos aún en contra de la voluntad de la madre del último.

programme.title: El Llanto de los Pobres
programme.desc: Un joven ilegal es acusado por un robo que no cometió, purga una condena en la cárcel donde sueña con volver a su país.

programme.title: La trenza
programme.desc: Un pueblo confundido por la religión, persigue a una mujer que robó la trenza de la estatua de la Virgen.

programme.title: Fútbol de alcoba
programme.desc: Un equipo de fútbol femenino se dirige a la capital para competir. Para reforzarlo, el entrenador se viste de mujer.

programme.title: Secuestro
programme.desc: Urgido de dinero, un publicista (Richard Grieco) se suma a los planes de un secuestrador (Michele Greene).

programme.title: El Placer de la Venganza
programme.desc: Una doctora y su familia son agredidos durante un robo, y después se encuentra a un joven que tomó parte en el ataque.

programme.title: Bello amanecer
programme.desc: La espectacular belleza de una isleña que despierta entre los pescadores las más ardientes y locas pasiones.

programme.title: Mi nombre es Gatillo
programme.desc: Un hombre llamado el "Gatillo" solo tiene violencia en su sangre y su vida está controlada por las armas.

programme.title: Impaciencia del corazón
programme.desc: Un capitán herido es llevado a un pequeño pueblo y una joven lo cuida. Al final dos mujeres se enamoran de él.

programme.title: Muertes anunciadas
programme.desc: Un niño busca venganza por la muerte brutal de toda su familia, a manos de una banda de asesinos.

programme.title: Las figuras de arena
programme.desc: Un joven acompaña a su padre a un pequeño pueblo y se enamora de una bella joven, sin saber que ella es una prostituta.

programme.title: Pasiones Infernales
programme.desc: Una mujer es maltratada por las mujeres de su aldea por el solo hecho de ser de color.

programme.title: Más negro que la noche
programme.desc: Tres hermosas mujeres se trasladan a una vieja casona, heredada por la tía de una de ellas, y presencian cosas extrañas.

programme.title: Condenados a Duelo
programme.desc: Dos hombres no se detendrán ante nada hasta cobrar venganza con la sangre del culpable.

programme.title: Hasta el viento tiene miedo
programme.desc: Un espíritu vengativo se apodera de una joven suicida en un centro de tratamientos. Sucesos misteriosos del pasado atormentan el presente.

programme.title: Las sobrinas del Diablo
programme.desc: Un cacique asesina al propietario de unas tierras y a su mujer para adueñarse de ellas. El criminal no contaba con que las hijas habían escapado y tratarán de vengarse con la ayuda del Diablo, quien las cuidó desde pequeñas.

programme.title: Escape Sangriento
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de sus cómplices, un narcotraficante planea un peligroso escape de prisión.

programme.title: El Pichichi del Barrio
programme.desc: El Pichichi es el entrenador de un equipo de fútbol femenino patrocinado por un narcotraficante ambicioso.

programme.title: El cachas de oro
programme.desc: Un conocido juez persigue a unos violadores y asesinos, hijos de Ramsein, y los mete a la cárcel, pero su padre los libera, por lo que el valiente juez se ve obligado a matarlos. Ramsein se vengará del juez matando a su prometida.
